projects.title: Clinic Queue Manager
projects.summary: A simple queue management prototype designed to help clinic staff keep track of patients during busy hours.
projects.role: Backend developer · Data structures and algorithms
projects.problem: Managing patient queues with paper lists can get confusing, especially when several patients arrive at once or someone needs urgent attention.
projects.approach: I used queue data structures to organize patient arrivals and added priority handling for urgent cases. I wanted to keep the logic simple and understand why each data structure was the right choice.
projects.outcome: Built a C++ prototype with features for patient check-in, priority handling, searching, and completing appointments. It was a good way to practice data structures and understand how they work in a practical scenario.
projects.metric: Evaluation pending: target 20% shorter average waiting time.

cover.alt: Queue dashboard concept showing patient sequence, wait time, and priority status

projects.title: Social Media Agent
projects.summary: An AI-powered tool that helps turn campaign ideas into social media drafts using the Gemini API.
projects.problem: Creating social media content for different platforms takes time. Teams often have to repeat the same research, writing, and formatting work for every campaign.
projects.approach: I built a workflow that takes a campaign brief, validates the input, and uses the Gemini API to generate structured content suggestions. I also included a human review step so generated content can be checked and edited before publishing.
projects.outcome: Built a prototype that generates multiple content drafts from a single brief and sends them through a review process. The idea is to make content creation easier while keeping people involved in the final decisions.
projects.metric: Evaluation pending: compare content review time across 10 representative campaign briefs.

cover.alt: Campaign workspace concept with a brief and three reviewed draft options
